DORA_Title: Organizational mission understood and informs cybersecurity risk management
Risk management objectives established and agreed by stakeholders
Cyber supply chain risk management programme established
Inventories of software services and systems managed
Vulnerabilities in assets identified and recorded
Identities and credentials managed for authorised users
Access permissions enforced on least privilege
Software is maintained replaced and patched
Computing hardware and software scanned for vulnerabilities
Incident response plan executed during an incident
Recovery plan executed during or after an incident
Backups of data created maintained and tested
